cohort: The cohort consisted of 150 pregnant women with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus and 150 healthy pregnant controls.
finding: Elevated serum Cys-C levels were significantly associated with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM), its complications (PIH, FGR), and adverse pregnancy outcomes including premature birth, fetal distress, and cesarean section.
mod_finding: Elevated Cys-C levels were positively correlated with cesarean section.
